activation.special: Source-unspecified command/handling timing uses native Special, not an invented action cost.

charges.behavior: ItemPF.addCharges changes uses.value for Charges; quantity changes only for physical Single Use. No consumable-specific auto-destroy field is invented.

container.components: Derived-source contents use stable keys/IDs, approved page hash and original parent source UUID.

medicSatchel.refill: Manual only while using the original satchel: new day or actual external spell point.
medicSatchel.weightAllocation: Published full weight/value stay on parent; no extra kit pound; separate supply mass/value unspecified.

entries.review: Requires the studied strike class feature. Add 1d6 to that feature's damage; when making a studied strike the wearer may spend one actual spell point to double its dice as stated. No ordinary weapon/spell damage bonus, feature grant or automatic spell-point expenditure. Published faint aura at CL ten conflicts with the native moderate label; preserve both facts under issue #31.

Move action to attach the telekinetic hook to a solid inanimate surface within two hundred feet; a second move action retracts the rod and wielder toward it at fifty feet per round. Free action to disconnect. Supports a load up to Huge size, not an invented pound limit. Movement, anchor choice and load remain manual; no physical rope or grappling weapon attack is bundled.

While worn, protects the wearer and worn/carried objects from sunlight, including sunlight blindness, sensitivity and vulnerability. The subtle haze does not interfere with vision; noticing it requires DC twenty-five Perception. A qualifying Light sphere or magical-light effect may suppress it with a successful magic skill check against the stated default MSD eighteen. No general darkness, attack concealment or blanket light immunity. Published faint aura at CL seven remains in the source while native strength is moderate; issue #31.

One handheld brush, a masterwork tool only for appropriate Craft uses such as calligraphy or painting. Produces permanent nonmagical ink of a chosen color without running out; change color as a free action. Its ink raises light by one step within five feet and can be removed like ordinary ink. No global Craft bonus, inventory ink stock or automatic scene-light changes.

entries.selectedVariant: one complete installed set; source gives no fixed bell count
entries.review: Affix this set of small bells to a door, window or object. Only gremlins within twenty feet of that installed set are nauseated and unable to use supernatural or spell-like abilities. No source-stated installation action time, daily pool or general all-creature aura is invented; target conditions and positioning remain manual.

Masterwork stringed instrument, not an instrument weapon. Playing or continuing is a standard action affecting all creatures within twenty feet. Will DC is ten plus half the player's actual Perform (strings) ranks plus Charisma modifier; do not substitute total skill bonus or item CL. The sonic mind-affecting compulsion is treated as staggered, lasts while the creature remains in the area and grants twenty-four-hour immunity to that fiddle after a successful save. Resolve music, saves, area and appropriate masterwork Perform bonus manually.

entries.selectedVariant: two qualifying psionic powers not yet selected
entries.review: Requires the psionics class feature. Choose two actual psionic powers whose initial range is at least sixty feet; increase only those ranges by thirty feet while worn. Reselect when the wearer regains spell points. No global casting-range increase, Charisma bonus, new powers or permanent grants.

Empty native container for actual stored objects. A standard action opens or closes a ten-foot-square doorway to ten contiguous ten-foot cubes whose arrangement is fixed when crafted. Contents persist with the key. Preserve the source Strength DC twenty-five / Escape Artist DC thirty exit rules, incoming air and forty-to-ninety Fahrenheit limits. Room layout, occupants, doorway movement and environmental influence remain manual. No fabricated room scene, nested compartments, pound limit or automatic weight exemption.

Creates bright light within seventy feet, with a further seventy-foot band raised one step to a maximum of normal light. Invisibility is negated only for creatures inside the bright area. No global see-invisibility flag, unrelated conventional lantern oil timer or automatic token/scene-light changes. Activation timing is not supplied by the source.

entries.selectedVariant: base 250 gp satchel; belt or chest attachment; ten kit uses
entries.review: One supply bundle inside the white satchel tracks ten uses of a healer's kit, not ten physical bandages. The base grants +2 circumstance to Heal when appropriately using the kit and counts as a healer's kit. At the beginning of each day, or after manually spending one actual spell point for an instantaneous full refill, restore its contained counter to ten. Refill remains manual and bag-dependent; loose supplies do not automatically regenerate. No blanket Heal modifier, upgraded bonus, faster recharge or unlimited-use tier is active. The listed price and full one-pound weight are counted once on the parent; separate supply weights/values are unspecified and need manual allocation if split away.

A hand-sized brass sphere becomes transparent with a command, revealing current celestial positions. Determines precise time and true north. The +4 circumstance Survival bonus applies only to avoiding getting lost; approximate world location and date require DC twenty Knowledge (geography). No general Survival/Knowledge bonus, magnetic-north substitution, larger mechanical orrery or invented command action time.

As a standard action, spread the six-foot cloth disk on a surface to create a cylindrical ten-foot-deep gap lasting one minute; three activations per day. Otherwise use Create Gap, including its structural-integrity, falling-creature save and expiry/shunting procedure. This is a temporary gap through an existing surface, not persistent storage. No contents, weight reduction, portable-hole air supply, permanent room or bag-of-holding destruction rule is inherited.

Empty hand-sized cloth bag or sewn-in pocket. Track both the one-cubic-foot and ten-pound storage limits; do not convert volume to an invented larger weight capacity. No contents are bundled. The source does not explicitly state a carried-weight exemption, so no automatic weight reduction is borrowed from a conventional Bag of Holding.

entries.selectedVariant: one reusable one-pound unit; 150 gp per pound
entries.review: Requires a Creation sphere caster using actual Creation abilities. Selected clay mass must equal or exceed the created object's weight. It may become only materials the caster can manipulate, never biologically reactive or chemically explosive substances, alchemical components, food or gemstones. The form persists until reused. Drawing it into the hand is free; shaping follows the actual Creation ability's action and cost. No quantity is consumed, free extra mass generated or ordinary clay-container stock bundled.

entries.selectedVariant: one ordinary-ink CL 1 quill in the usual mundane three-quill case; complete 80 gp package
entries.review: The metal carrying case itself is mundane; the one contained feather quill is CL one Creation. Two positions remain empty. The published eighty-gp package value is allocated to its quill, with no additional case price or non-negligible weight invented. The quill writes continuously without dripping and uses one ink type. Special ink requires five vials when crafting a special-ink quill; no special ink or extra quills are supplied.

entries.selectedVariant: one crafted blast-type talent not yet selected
entries.review: Contains one chosen blast-type talent for use while worn. For a wearer with favored element, changes only the first favored element to that talent's group; a GM-defined group may be needed. Does not stack with other favored elements. Wearing multiple such rings disables all of them until only one is worn. No Charisma/AC bonus, permanent talent grant or conventional elemental-command spell package.

Grants fast healing one only while actually held. Merely carrying or storing the rod is insufficient. Published price seventy-two thousand gp and the complete pricing FAQ are retained. No conventional healing-staff spells, automatic periodic HP changes, temporary HP variant or universal always-on healing modifier.

entries.selectedVariant: base cold-iron rod; fixed MSB +5; 150-foot range
entries.review: Use the Counterspell feat procedure to dispel an ongoing effect within one hundred fifty feet, or ready to counter an effect, using the rod's MSB +5. Resolve the actual feat's checks, requirements, costs and target outcomes manually; no spell-point pool or item daily limit is invented. Each additional MSB costs two thousand gp, with half that crafting cost, and cannot exceed the creator/improver's MSB. Improvements are separate from this base profile; no arcanist reservoir or Rod of Cancellation item-destruction ability.

entries.selectedVariant: base cursed symbol; neck selected for native slot; current energy chosen manually
entries.review: A spherecaster must wear it in an actual magical item slot; this profile selects neck, which may be changed to another permitted worn slot. Once per round when enemies are within fifty feet, even undetected, its spread deals ten of the current acid/cold/electricity/fire type to enemies, going around corners but not solid barriers. Objects are not damaged unless enemies. Change the one current energy as a standard action. The five published casting drawbacks apply and stack with existing copies; no automatic aura damage, enemy classification, drawback grants or global concentration penalties.

entries.selectedVariant: base 150 gp cuffs; pins/needles and four-hundred-foot daily thread allowance
entries.review: Pearl-headed pins and spare needles are replaced if damaged or more than four hundred feet from the cuffs, destroying the old one. Pulling thread unravels it until cut, up to four hundred feet per day. The manual counter is remaining feet, not activations or a fixed needle count; after producing thread, manually subtract its actual length. The helper costs zero and creates no inventory objects. Clothing creation starts only at the separate fifth-level upgrade; no base suit creation or invented pull action time.
